assertions: Python composition constructs LegacyEngineFacade over the existing FishingBot.
Python production source has no reference to the offline native Engine or managed gate.
The native executable refuses startup unless the explicit offline gate marker is present.
The managed and native product source ownership gates reject Python/PySide/Nuitka/legacy runtime dependencies.
The Host assigns the child to a Common kill-on-close Job before handshake.
The Host accepts both private pipe channels through the Common PID-gated server pair.
The runnable WPF Host requires an explicit demo or offline Engine mode and does not expose production commands.
No Python pipe framing, PID verification, handshake, heartbeat, or security loop exists in the product repository.
No product Python bridge setup or worker entrypoint exists; Python remains a nonshipping characterization oracle only.
The handshake advertises no side-effect support and accepts no side-effect authority.
The Host applies one complete validated persisted settings snapshot and the Engine exposes its exact accepted revision.
The Engine event channel has one cancellable writer: safety/lifecycle frames are priority-bounded and latest aggregate snapshots coalesce through frozen Common buffers.
The Engine rejects semantically duplicate hotkeys and the Host blocks saving the same conflict.
Fishing consumes the frozen Common Windows process, window and packet-budget package without copying those generic mechanisms.
The real native chat capture, detector and mutation adapters exist only behind disabled composition; no offline IPC command can construct or invoke them.
Native chat mutations use exact-budget complete pulse batches, partial-prefix release cleanup and cancellable waits without granting production side-effect authority.
The native fishing-stage detector consumes only embedded hash-pinned templates and immutable frames; live capture is not composed and no Host frame/detector command exists.

The native inventory-store episode owns menu dismissal, stage exit, inventory open, item reflow, remove confirmation, bounded cleanup and optional resume behind one final-sequence mutation port; no live observer, mutation adapter or Host command is composed.

The native fishing episode owns casting, hooking and reeling as one cancellable Engine operation over coherent stage/memory observations and one exclusive lease; every typed intent reaches an immediate final gate, while the live observer and mutation adapter remain disabled and no Host step command exists.

The native meal, garbage and equipment recovery capabilities execute as coarse Engine-owned operations inside the same inventory session and exact-sequence mutation port; bounded confirmation, recovery and terminal outcomes cannot bypass the disabled live composition.
Host and Engine independently verify the same exact signed entitlement raw bytes and product claims through frozen Common managed 0.1.3 and native 0.1.2 packages.
The production Keygen RSA public key is absent; the unrelated startup-block Ed25519 key is never reused and automation admission remains fail-closed.
FishingBot calls the Python catch-disposition oracle before its existing keep/release side effect.
The offline catch-disposition result is diagnostic and cannot authorize physical input.
The offline native target is disabled by default and excluded from current packaging.
removal_gate: Change production authority only after product behavior parity, coarse session contract, safety and crash gates, release allowlist verification, explicit cutover, and rollback acceptance.
